self.surface)\n        self.planner = OrienteeringPlanner(rules, self.pf)\n\n        self.targets_by_id: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {t[\"id\"]: dict(t) for t in world[\"targets\"]}\n        self.planner.update_targets(world[\"base\"], list(self.targets_by_id.values()))\n        self.base_nav: NavigationField = self.pf.build_navigation_field(self.base_x, self.base_y)\n\n        self.active_target_id: Optional[str] = None\n        self.active_nav: Optional[NavigationField] = None\n\n        self.planned_tour: List[str] = []\n        self.pending_samples: Dict[str, int] = {}  # target_id -> exec_tick of scheduled sample\n        self.miss_counts: Dict[str, int] = {}\n        self.abandoned_ids: Set[str] = set()\n        self.returning_home = False\n\n        self.graph_refreshed_25 = False\n        self.graph_refreshed_85 = False\n\n    def log(self, msg: str) -> None:\n        if self.verbose:\n            print(f\"[M{self.mission_id}] {msg}\", flush=True)\n\n    def unavailable_target_ids(self) -> Set[str]:\n        return set(self.est.sampled_targets) | set(self.pending_samples.keys()) | set(self.abandoned_ids)\n\n    def _sync_map_discoveries(self) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Fetch map() and incorporate any newly discovered targets. Returns True if new targets added.\"\"\"\n        latest_world = self.tools.map()\n        if int(latest_world.get(\"mission\", self.mission_id)) != self.mission_id:\n            return False\n        added = False\n        for t in latest_world[\"targets\"]:\n            tid = t[\"id\"]\n            if tid not in self.targets_by_id:\n                self.targets_by_id[tid] = dict(t)\n                added = True\n                self.log(\n                    f\"DISCOVERY {tid} at ({t['x']:.1f},{t['y']:.1f}) val={t['value']} dl={t['deadline_tick']}\"\n                )\n        if added:\n            self.world = latest_world\n            self.planner.update_targets(self.world[\"base\"], list(self.targets_by_id.values()))\n        return added\n\n    def _replan(self, exec_tick: int, pred: Dict[str, Any], budget_s: float, rebuild_graph: bool = False) -> None:\n        if self.returning_home:\n            return\n        if rebuild_graph:\n            self.pf.rebuild_graph(self.est.slip_mean)\n            self.planner.update_targets(self.world[\"base\"], list(self.targets_by_id.values()))\n            self.base_nav = self.pf.build_navigation_field(self.base_x, self.base_y)\n            self.active_nav = None\n\n        unavail = self.unavailable_target_ids()\n        rem_warm = [tid for tid in self.planned_tour if tid not in unavail]\n        new_tour, est_sc, end_t = self.planner.solve_tour(\n            start_x=pred[\"x\"],\n            start_y=pred[\"y\"],\n            start_tick=exec_tick,\n            start_batt=pred[\"battery_nom\"],\n            solar_eff=self.est.solar_eff_est,\n            unavailable_ids=unavail,\n            warm_tour_ids=rem_warm,\n            max_return_tick=409,\n            time_budget_s=budget_s,\n            seed=self.mission_id * 1000 + exec_tick,\n        )\n        self.planned_tour = new_tour\n        if self.active_target_id not in new_tour[:1]:\n            self.active_target_id = None\n            self.active_nav = None\n        self.log(\n            f\"t_exec={exec_tick:3d} Plan ({len(new_tour)} rem, est_rem_val={est_sc:.2f}, ret_tick={end_t}): {new_tour[:8]}\"\n            + (\"...\" if len(new_tour) > 8 else \"\")\n        )\n\n    def _estimate_ticks_and_energy_home(self, px: float, py: float) -> Tuple[float, float]:\n        d_base = math.hypot(px - self.base_x, py - self.base_y)\n        if d_base <= 2.2:\n            return 0.0, 0.0\n        if d_base <= 16.0:\n            tk_d, en_d, min_c = self.pf.segment_travel_stats(px, py, self.base_x, self.base_y)\n            if tk_d < 1e8 and min_c >= 2.0:\n                return tk_d + 0.5, en_d\n        u = self.pf.coord_to_node(px, py)\n        ucx, ucy = self.pf.node_to_coord(u)\n        off = math.hypot(px - ucx, py - ucy)\n        return self.base_nav.ticks_to_go[u] + 0.8 + 0.22 * off, self.base_nav.energy_to_go[u] + 0.35 * off\n\n    def _must_return_home(self, exec_tick: int, px: float, py: float, batt_cons: float) -> bool:\n        tk_home, en_home = self._estimate_ticks_and_energy_home(px, py)\n        drive_ticks = int(math.ceil(tk_home * 1.08 + 1.0))\n        # Simulate conservative battery on way home to count any required solar wait ticks\n        sim_t = exec_tick\n        b = batt_cons\n        wait_ticks = 0\n        per_tick_e = en_home / max(1, drive_ticks)\n        for _ in range(drive_ticks):\n            if sim_t >= self.max_ticks:\n                return True\n            while (min(100.0, b + self.est.solar_gain_est(sim_t, conservative=True)) - self.idle_cost - per_tick_e) < 7.5:\n                b = min(100.0, b + self.est.solar_gain_est(sim_t, conservative=True)) - self.idle_cost\n                sim_t += 1\n                wait_ticks += 1\n                if sim_t >= self.max_ticks:\n                    return True\n            b = min(100.0, b + self.est.solar_gain_est(sim_t, conservative=True)) - self.idle_cost - per_tick_e\n            sim_t += 1\n        # Keep 7 ticks buffer at end for closed-loop base parking\n        return (exec_tick + drive_ticks + wait_ticks + 7) >= self.max_ticks\n\n    def _is_drive_safe(self, px: float, py: float, pbias: float, h_cmd: float, m_cmd: float,\n                       slope_cap: float = 0.332) -> Tuple[bool, float]:\n        \"\"\"Verify drive under heading/slip perturbations never hits tilt or boundary stop. Returns (safe, max_energy).\"\"\"\n        max_e = 0.0\n        for dh in (-5.0, -2.5, 0.0, 2.5, 5.0):\n            for sn in (-0.025, 0.025):\n                res = drive(self.surface, PHYSICS, px, py, h_cmd + pbias + dh, m_cmd, self.est.slip_mean, noise=sn)\n                if res[\"stop\"] is not None:\n                    return False, 999.0\n                if self.surface.slope(res[\"x\"], res[\"y\"]) > slope_cap:\n                    return False, 999.0\n                if res[\"energy\"] > max_e:\n                    max_e = res[\"energy\"]\n        return True, max_e\n\n    def _compute_safe_drive(self, px: float, py: float, pbias: float,\n                            wx: float, wy: float, chord_clr: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        dx = wx - px\n        dy = wy - py\n        dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)\n        if dist < 0.06:\n            return {\"action\": \"wait\"}\n\n        goal_ang = math.degrees(math.atan2(dy, dx))\n        if chord_clr >= 4.0:\n            max_m = 5.0\n        elif chord_clr >= 2.5:\n            max_m = 3.6\n        else:\n            max_m = 2.2\n\n        _, gx, gy, code = self.surface.sample(px, py)\n        tname = TERRAIN_CODES[code]\n        rad_g = math.radians(goal_ang)\n        grade_approx = gx * math.cos(rad_g) + gy * math.sin(rad_g)\n        slip_approx = min(0.88, self.est.slip_mean[tname] + PHYSICS[\"slip_grade_gain\"][tname] * max(0.0, grade_approx))\n\n        h_cmd = goal_ang - pbias\n        m_cmd = min(max_m, max(0.08, dist / max(0.15, 1.0 - slip_approx)))\n\n        # 3-iteration inverse-kinematics refinement using exact surface drive()\n        for _ in range(3):\n            res = drive(self.surface, PHYSICS, px, py, h_cmd + pbias, m_cmd, self.est.slip_mean)\n            rx = res[\"x\"] - px\n            ry = res[\"y\"] - py\n            rg = math.hypot(rx, ry)\n            if rg > 1e-4:\n                act_ang = math.degrees(math.atan2(ry, rx))\n                err_ang = ((act_ang - goal_ang + 180.0) % 360.0) - 180.0\n                h_cmd -= err_ang\n                if dist < rg or m_cmd < max_m - 1e-4:\n                    m_cmd = min(max_m, max(0.08, m_cmd * (dist / rg)))\n\n        h_cmd = ((h_cmd + 180.0) % 360.0) - 180.0\n        safe, max_e = self._is_drive_safe(px, py, pbias, h_cmd, m_cmd)\n        if safe:\n            return {\n                \"action\": \"drive\",\n                \"heading_deg\": round(h_cmd, 3),\n                \"metres\": round(m_cmd, 3),\n                \"_max_e\": max_e,\n            }\n\n        # Fallback search over shorter distances & heading offsets away from hazards\n        ux_goal, uy_goal = dx / dist, dy / dist\n        best_cmd: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None\n        best_val = -1e9\n        for scale in (0.75, 0.50, 0.30):\n            test_m = max(0.15, m_cmd * scale)\n            for off_deg in (0.0, -18.0, 18.0, -38.0, 38.0, -65.0, 65.0, -95.0, 95.0, 180.0):\n                th = ((goal_ang - pbias + off_deg + 180.0) % 360.0) - 180.0\n                ok, me = self._is_drive_safe(px, py, pbias, th, test_m, slope_cap=0.340)\n                if not ok:\n                    continue\n                res = drive(self.surface, PHYSICS, px, py, th + pbias, test_m, self.est.slip_mean)\n                prog = (res[\"x\"] - px) * ux_goal + (res[\"y\"] - py) * uy_goal\n                clr_bonus = 0.6 * self.pf.clearance_at(res[\"x\"], res[\"y\"])\n                score = prog + clr_bonus\n                if score > best_val:\n                    best_val = score\n                    best_cmd = {\n                        \"action\": \"drive\",\n                        \"heading_deg\": round(th, 3),\n                        \"metres\": round(test_m, 3),\n                        \"_max_e\": me,\n                    }\n            if best_cmd is not None and best_val > 0.5:\n                return best_cmd\n\n        if best_cmd is not None:\n            return best_cmd\n        return {\"action\": \"wait\"}\n\n    def _count_in_flight_drives(self, exec_tick: int) -> int:\n        cnt = 0\n        for s_t in range(self.est.last_obs_tick + 1, exec_tick):\n            cmd = self.est.sent_cmds.get(s_t)\n            if cmd is not None and cmd.get(\"action\") == \"drive\":\n                cnt += 1\n        return cnt\n\n    def choose_command(self, current_tick: int, exec_tick: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        pred = self.est.predict_state_at_tick(exec_tick, n_ens=36)\n        px, py = pred[\"x\"], pred[\"y\"]\n        pbias = pred[\"heading_bias\"]\n        pts = pred[\"particles_xy\"]\n        batt_cons = pred[\"battery_cons\"]\n\n        # Periodic replanning & parameter-adapted graph updates\n        obs_t = self.est.last_obs_tick\n        if not self.graph_refreshed_25 and obs_t >= 25:\n            self.graph_refreshed_25 = True\n            self._replan(exec_tick, pred, budget_s=0.45, rebuild_graph=True)\n        elif not self.graph_refreshed_85 and obs_t >= 85:\n            self.graph_refreshed_85 = True\n            self._replan(exec_tick, pred, budget_s=0.45, rebuild_graph=True)\n        elif current_tick > 0 and current_tick % 35 == 0 and not self.returning_home:\n            self._replan(exec_tick, pred, budget_s=0.25, rebuild_graph=False)\n\n        # Clean out completed/abandoned targets from head of planned_tour\n        unavail = self.unavailable_target_ids()\n        while self.planned_tour and self.planned_tour[0] in unavail:\n            self.planned_tour.pop(0)\n\n        # Check return-to-base safety condition\n        if not self.returning_home:\n            if not self.planned_tour or self._must_return_home(exec_tick, px, py, batt_cons):\n                self.returning_home = True\n                self.active_target_id = None\n                self.active_nav = None\n                self.log(f\"t_exec={exec_tick:3d} RETURN_TO_BASE engaged from ({px:.1f},{py:.1f}), batt_cons={batt_cons:.1f}\")\n\n        # --- MODE A: RETURN TO BASE ---\n        if self.returning_home:\n            d_base = math.hypot(px - self.base_x, py - self.base_y)\n            n_pts = len(pts)\n            in_base = sum(\n                1 for (qx, qy) in pts\n                if math.hypot(qx - self.base_x, qy - self.base_y) <= (self.base_radius - 0.45)\n            )\n            if d_base <= 1.25 and in_base >= int(0.95 * n_pts):\n                return {\"action\": \"wait\"}\n            if d_base <= 0.70 and self._count_in_flight_drives(exec_tick) >= 2:\n                return {\"action\": \"wait\"}\n\n            wx, wy, clr = self.pf.get_local_waypoint(px, py, self.base_nav)\n            raw_cmd = self._compute_safe_drive(px, py, pbias, wx, wy, clr)\n            if raw_cmd[\"action\"] == \"drive\":\n                max_e = raw_cmd.pop(\"_max_e\", 3.5)\n                next_batt = min(100.0, batt_cons + self.est.solar_gain_est(exec_tick, conservative=True)) - self.idle_cost - max_e\n                if next_batt < 4.5:\n                    return {\"action\": \"wait\"}\n            return raw_cmd\n\n        # --- MODE B: PURSUE NEXT TARGET ---\n        tid = self.planned_tour[0]\n        tgt = self.targets_by_id[tid]\n        tx, ty = float(tgt[\"x\"]), float(tgt[\"y\"])\n\n        if self.active_target_id != tid or self.active_nav is None:\n            self.active_target_id = tid\n            self.active_nav = self.pf.build_navigation_field(tx, ty)\n\n        d_mean = math.hypot(px - tx, py - ty)\n        n_pts = len(pts)\n        in_220 = sum(1 for (qx, qy) in pts if math.hypot(qx - tx, qy - ty) <= 2.20)\n        in_238 = sum(1 for (qx, qy) in pts if math.hypot(qx - tx, qy - ty) <= 2.38)\n        in_flight_drives =           or (d_mean <= 1.80 and in_flight_drives == 0)\n        )\n\n        if ready_to_sample and exec_tick >= int(tgt.get(\"appear_tick\", 0)):\n            next_batt = (\n                min(100.0, batt_cons + self.est.solar_gain_est(exec_tick, conservative=True))\n                - self.idle_cost\n                - self.sample_cost\n            )\n            if next_batt < 8.0:\n                return {\"action\": \"wait\"}\n            self.pending_samples[tid] = exec_tick\n            self.log(\n                f\"t_exec={exec_tick:3d} SAMPLE {tid} (val={tgt['value']}, dl={tgt['deadline_tick']}) \"\n                f\"pred_dist={d_mean:.2f}m conf={in_238}/{n_pts} batt={pred['battery_nom']:.1f}\"\n            )\n            return {\"action\": \"sample\"}\n\n        # If mean is already dead-on target (< 0.75m) while pipeline uncertainty is settling, pause 1 tick\n        if d_mean <= 0.75 and in_flight_drives >= 2:\n            return {\"action\": \"wait\"}\n\n   max_e = raw_cmd.pop(\"_max_e\", 3.5)\n            next_batt = min(100.0, batt_cons + self.est.solar_gain_est(exec_tick, conservative=True)) - self.idle_cost - max_e\n            if next_batt < 9.5:\n                return {\"action\": \"wait\"}\n        return raw_cmd\n\n    def run_mission(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:\n        \"\"\"Execute full mission loop until episode_complete is True.\"\"\"\n        # Assimilate any telemetry already received (e.g. tick 0 briefing, or resumed session)\n        initial_pkts = sorted(self.tools.telemetry_log(), key=lambda p: int(p[\"tick\"]))\n        current_tick = 0\n        for pkt in initial_pkts:\n            if int(pkt.get(\"mission\", self.mission_id)) == self.mission_id:\n                self.est.process_packet(pkt)\n                rec_t = int(pkt.get(\"received_tick\", 0))\n                if rec_t > current_tick:\n                    current_tick = rec_t\n\n        # Initial global tour optimization\n        init_exec = current_tick + self.delay_ticks + 1\n        pred0 = self.est.predict_state_at_tick(init_exec, n_ens=36)\n        self._replan(init_exec, pred0, budget_s=1.6, rebuild_graph=False)\n\n        while True:\n            next_exec = max(current_tick + self.delay_ticks + 1, self.est.last_reserved_tick + 1)\n            if next_exec <= self.max_ticks and self.est.alive:\n                cmd = self.choose_command(current_tick, next_exec)\n                try:\n                    acks = self.tools.uplink([cmd])\n                    self.est.record_uplink([cmd], acks)\n                except post-uplink ticks 417..420)\n            step_ticks = 1 if (current_tick + self.delay_ticks + 1) <= self.max_ticks else min(5, max(1, self.max_ticks - current_tick))\n            out = {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794711009632,"sessionID":"ses_e22f5813cffevB9fQr601a70HB","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"IypUoErNC9uJ3FAZ","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Full 3-mission campaign autopilot for Lightlag Traverse.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport sys\nimport time\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom lightlag_client import connect\nfrom rover_controller import MissionController\n\n\ndef run_campaign(tools: Any, verbose: bool = True) -> None:\n    t0 = time.perf_counter()\n    rules = tools.rules()\n    if rules.get(\"campaign\", {}).get(\"complete\", False):\n        print(\"Campaign already marked complete in rules().\", flush=True)\n        return\n\n    while True:\n        rules = tools.rules()\n        if rules.get(\"campaign\", {}).get(\"complete\", False):\n            print(\"Campaign complete!\", flush=True)\n            break\n        world = tools.map()\n        mission_num = int(world[\"mission\"])\n        missions_total = int(world.get(\"missions\", rules[\"campaign\"][\"missions\"]))\n        print(\n            f\"=== Starting Mission {mission_num}/{missions_total} \"\n            f\"(base={world['base']}, initial_targets={len(world['targets'])}) ===\",\n            flush=True,\n        )\n        mc = MissionController(tools, rules, world, verbose=verbose)\n        out = mc.run_mission()\n        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - t0\n        print(\n            f\"=== Mission {mission_num} ended (elapsed={elapsed:.1f}s, \"\n            f\"episode_complete={out.get('episode_complete')}, \"\n            f\"campaign_complete={out.get('campaign_complete')}) ===\",\n            flush=True,\n        )\n        if out.get(\"campaign_complete\", False):\n            print(f\"ALL {missions_total} MISSIONS COMPLETE in {elapsed:.1f}s!\", flush=True)\n            break\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=\"Lightlag Traverse Autopilot\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--url\", default=\"http://lightlag:8000/mcp\", help=\"MCP endpoint URL\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--local-seed\", type=int, default=None, help=\"Run against local simulator seed instead of live MCP\")\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n\n    if args.local_seed is not None:\n        sys.path.insert(0, \"/tmp/opencode\")\n        from local_sim import LocalCampaignTools\n        import json\n\n        sim = LocalCampaignTools(seed=args.local_seed)\n        run_campaign(sim, verbose=True)\n        print(\"\\n=== LOCAL CAMPAIGN TRUE SCORE SUMMARY ===\", flush=True)\n        print(json.dumps(sim.campaign_summary(), indent=2), flush=True)\n        return 0\n\n    with connect(args.url) as tools:\n        run_campaign(tools, verbose=True)\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n","filePath":"/app/autopilot.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/autopilot.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/autopilot.py","time":{"start":1794711009628,"end":1794711009631}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dd1cb957001JszaeiQWPLlx9Q","sessionID":"ses_e22f5813cffevB9fQr601a70HB","messageID":"msg_1dd1c7ecf001Qs1yAZVBMP7JIt"}}

{"type":"reasoning","timestamp":1794711231206,"sessionID":"ses_e22f5813cffevB9fQr601a70HB","part":{"id":"prt_1dd1eb2ca001WDY7eaQ3kYAlzB","messageID":"msg_1dd1e908f001W98gOTPF21puhb","sessionID":"ses_e22f5813cffevB9fQr601a70HB","type":"reasoning","text":"**Analyzing System Resilience**\n\nI'm incredibly relieved! `local_sim.py` proved its worth. The output showed both the system's strength and, crucially, a mission 3 bug we just averted. It's a testament to the benefits of testing locally!\n\n\n**Reviewing Mission Performance**\n\nI see a clear picture now. Missions 1 and 2 were flawless: perfect hit rates and respectable earnings. However, Mission 3 is a head-scratcher. It returned to base from a far corner with a critically low battery. The return-to-base sequence kicked in, indicating a battery issue far from the base. This is the issue we need to focus on next!\n\n\n**Pinpointing Critical Errors**\n\nI've hit paydirt! I found two critical bugs in `rover_planner.py`'s `eval_seq`, specifically in the return-to-base logic. The driving ticks `dt_ret` aren't being updated inside the `while` loop when additional wait ticks are introduced. That's bug number one.\n\nBug number two is the source of our problem, and is a big one: `b_end = min(100.0, batt + (sol_cum[t + dt_ret] - sol_cum[t]) - de_ret)`. The `min` function's behavior means that a depleted battery, that can be easily remedied by charging is always being reported as at maximum battery. This means the planner completely ignores that the charge is critically low on the final trip. These two bugs completely explain mission 3, and mission 3 alone!\n\n\n**Investigating Energy Calculations**\n\nI'm now zeroing in on Mission 3's energy woes. The `b_end` cap was in place, which, on its own, seems not an issue. More importantly, I'm concerned with what happened from ticks 242-288, as the rover drove far, but ran low on battery for the return. Calculating the energy available from ticks 288-420, it appears late-day sunlight alone was insufficient to enable the return to base. The numbers are: about 125 energy units from sunlight plus 34 units (initial battery) meaning ~159 total energy. This suggests the return to base needed more energy than what was available from late-sol sunlight from that far point, the location to which the rover should not have been instructed to head, given the available energy at that time!\n\n\n**Examining Energy Consumption**\n\nI'm now diving deep into why the energy estimates were off. The 380m trek across site #3, a challenging terrain, consumed significantly more energy than predicted, around 185 units. My initial focus is on why `eval_seq` underestimated the return energy demand. I'm seeing two primary factors at play: the underestimation of energy usage due to terrain variations, and the approximation of the battery level with `sol_cum` in `eval_seq`. The elevation smoothing in `_fast_edge_stats` overlooks micro-undulations that increase energy consumption, and crabbing also adds to the deficit. I'm cross-referencing this now with Mission 2 and 3 battery logs to validate these observations. I'll need to carefully reconsider the energy modeling to account for these nuances.\n\n\n**Refining Energy Model**\n\nThe seed screening speed is now incredibly fast, just 150ms! I've been dissecting the return leg logic, especially `dt_ret`, which can be up to 90 ticks long for a 380m distance from Base. I've realized `b_end = min(100.0, batt + (sol_cum[t + dt_ret] - sol_cum[t]) - de_ret)` was being treated as a **single** 90-tick chunk! This is the core issue! If every leg, including the return, is chunked into 8-tick steps, and a 1.10x energy safety multiplier is used, it will never allow driving out to the far SW corner.\n\n\n\n**Improving Return Logic**\n\nI'm now zeroing in on the flaws in our return logic, as a priority. I'm focusing on the `_must_return_home` function. Why didn't it trigger before `t=288`? It looks like `_must_return_home` waited until the margin was only 7 ticks, despite the energy being tight and no safety factors being incorporated. If `_must_return_home` and `eval_seq` both had tighter energy and time margins, the issues in mission 3 would've been averted!\n\n\n**Validating Log Analysis**\n\nI'm thrilled with the latest findings! It turns out, by examining the logs of Mission 1, 2, and 3, I've discovered a way to improve our approach and strategy. The rover could've picked more targets when returning toward base, earning even more points and finishing closer to base. I'm now looking at Mission 1, 2, and 3 logs to identify further subtle improvements to the overall campaign!\n\n\n**Confirming Discovery Efficiency**\n\nI'm incredibly pleased with the latest results! Our replanning strategy is hitting its mark. Across all three missions, we have achieved a flawless record: **18/18 and 19/19 samples, achieving a 100% hit rate, with zero misses!** Furthermore, there were **zero safety stops** needed across all 1260 ticks, which is a fantastic outcome.\n\n\n**Evaluating Replanning Strategy**\n\nI'm now investigating a crucial point in Mission 3. Why did the rover choose a low-value target instead of a potentially higher-value one? The replanning logic favors single-target insertions, but what if a more valuable target requires dropping two low-value ones? The current strategy is missing 1-for-2 replacements, which would affect `ret_tick` values.\n\n\n**Implementing Replanning Fixes**\n\nI've got it! I need to re-think `local_improve`. It's crucial to allow dropping low-value targets at the tour's end to accommodate higher-value insertions. I see now that dropping a target from the tail in the current `local_improve` can still be missed. I'm adding an \"Insert-with-Lowest-Value-Trim\" strategy to `local_improve` right away! This will ensure the solver isn't missing potentially better target combinations.\n\n\n**Refining Tour Optimization**\n\nI'm now implementing crucial enhancements to `local_improve`. The core issue is allowing high-value targets to displace lower ones, even if it means trimming the tour. I'm adding a \"Insert-with-Lowest-Value-Trim\" strategy that evaluates the insertion of a high-value target while dropping one or two low-value targets. This ensures the best target combinations are always considered and the solver isn't missing potentially better combinations.\n\n\n","time":{"start":1794711139019,"end":1794711231203}}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794711254659,"sessionID":"ses_e22f5813cffevB9fQr601a70HB","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"edit","callID":"RRSfBhc1JmqRloj9","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/app/rover_controller.py","newString":"    def _simulate_leg_ticks_and_batt(self, start_t: int, start_b: float, raw_ticks: float,\n                                     raw_energy: float, min_batt: float = 8.5) -> Tuple[int, float, bool]:\n        \"\"\"Simulate conservative ticks & battery across a leg with 1.10x tick and 1.15x energy safety margin.\"\"\"\n        drive_ticks = max(1, int(math.ceil(raw_ticks * 1.10 + 1.0)))\n        total_e = raw_energy * 1.15\n        per_tick_e = total_e / drive_ticks\n        sim_t = start_t\n        b = start_b\n        for _ in range(drive_ticks):\n            if sim_t >= self.max_ticks:\n                return sim_t, b, False\n            while (min(100.0, b + self.est.solar_gain_est(sim_t, conservative=True)) - self.idle_cost - per_tick_e) < min_batt:\n                b = min(100.0, b + self.est.solar_gain_est(sim_t, conservative=True)) - self.idle_cost\n                sim_t += 1\n                if sim_t >= self.max_ticks:\n                    return sim_t, b, False\n            b = min(100.0, b + self.est.solar_gain_est(sim_t, conservative=True)) - self.idle_cost - per_tick_e\n            sim_t += 1\n        return sim_t, b, True\n\n    def _must_return_home(self, exec_tick: int, px: float, py: float, batt_cons: float) -> bool:\n        tk_home, en_home = self._estimate_ticks_and_energy_home(px, py)\n        if tk_home <= 0.1:\n            return exec_tick >= (self.max_ticks - 8)\n        end_t, _, ok = self._simulate_leg_ticks_and_batt(exec_tick, batt_cons, tk_home, en_home, min_batt=8.5)\n        if not ok:\n            return True\n        return (end_t + 9) >= self.max_ticks\n\n    def _can_safely_visit_then_home(self, exec_tick: int, px: float, py: float, batt_cons: float,\n                                    tid: str, nav: NavigationField) -> bool:\n        tgt = self.targets_by_id[tid]\n        tx, ty = float(tgt[\"x\"]), float(tgt[\"y\"])\n        d = math.hypot(px - tx, py - ty)\n        if d <= 2.2:\n            tk_to, en_to = 0.0, 0.0\n        else:\n            u = self.pf.coord_to_node(px, py)\n            tk_to = nav.ticks_to_go[u] + 1.0\n            en_to = nav.energy_to_go[u] + 0.5\n        t_arr, b_arr, ok1 = self._simulate_leg_ticks_and_batt(exec_tick, batt_cons, tk_to, en_to, min_batt=9.5)\n        if not ok1 or t_arr + 2 >= self.max_ticks:\n            return False\n        # Sample tick\n        b_after_s = min(100.0, b_arr + self.est.solar_gain_est(t_arr, conservative=True)) - self.idle_cost\n            t_dep += 1\n        # Home leg from target\n        tk_h, en_h = self._estimate_ticks_and_energy_home(tx, ty)\n        t_end, _, ok2 = self._simulate_leg_ticks_and_batt(t_dep, b_after_s, tk_h, en_h, min_batt=8.5)\n        return ok2 and (t_end + 8) <= self.max_ticks","oldString":"    def _must_return_home(self, exec_tick: int, px: float, py: float, batt_cons: float) -> bool:\n        tk_home, en_home = self._estimate_ticks_and_energy_home(px, py)\n        drive_ticks = int(math.ceil(tk_home * 1.08 + 1.0))\n        # Simulate conservative battery on way home to count any required solar wait ticks\n        sim_t = exec_tick\n        b = batt_cons\n        wait_ticks = 0\n        per_tick_e = en_home / max(1, drive_ticks)\n        for _ in range(drive_ticks):\n            if sim_t >= self.max_ticks:\n                return True\n            while (min(100.0, b + self.est.solar_gain_est(sim_t, conservative=True)) - {"type":"reasoning","timestamp":1794711668772,"sessionID":"ses_e22f5813cffevB9fQr601a70HB","part":{"id":"prt_1dd25cd2a001bstvqwFoELFBsy","messageID":"msg_1dd25ad06001Z3FjM0aFEhfIGa","sessionID":"ses_e22f5813cffevB9fQr601a70HB","type":"reasoning","text":"**Discovering Crucial Bugs**\n\nI've just uncovered two significant, insidious bugs within a single trace! Observing `obs_t=193..195`, the log reveals a discrepancy between `true` and `est_now` at (575.00, 204.24) and (574.88, 207.63). This is accompanied by an unexpected safety stop event, suggesting a critical issue.\n\n\n**Analyzing Command Queues**\n\nI've been drilling down into the impact of the `safety_stop` events, and I've found a critical command queue issue at `obs_t=193`. Previously, I had assumed that the error in `est_now` at tick `193` was caused by a discrepancy between `true` and `est_now`. However, the rover's command queue was cleared due to the `safety_stop` event at rover tick `193`, which arrived in the telemetry at `current_tick = 196`. This indicates commands intended for execution at later ticks were unexpectedly cancelled.\n\n\n**Pinpointing Timing Errors**\n\nNow I've identified the root cause: a critical timing discrepancy in how future commands were handled. Before packet 193 arrived at tick 196, the rover planned to execute commands at ticks 197, 198, and 199. These commands were sent after rover tick 193. Our estimator incorrectly cleared these commands. The key is now adding \"_sent_tick\" to our command dict!\n\n\n**Uncovering Safety Stop Cause**\n\nI've finally tracked down the elusive reason for the safety stop at `obs_t = 193`. The `_is_drive_safe` function in `rover_controller.py` solely uses the mean position, `(px, py)`, to check for safe driving conditions. However, the rover's true position was significantly offset from this mean at the critical moment, being 0.8m further away from a crater wall. This offset meant the safety check failed to account for the uncertainty, leading to the rover's movement INTO a slope that exceeded the safe threshold and triggered the safety stop. To solve this, I plan to improve the function to account for positioning uncertainty.\n\n\n**Refining Safety Parameters**\n\nI'm now integrating crucial safety enhancements. I'm focusing on incorporating extreme cardinal offsets, using `(px ± r_uncert, py ± r_uncert)`, into the clearance check, and ensuring a clearance of at least 2.0 meters. Additionally, I'm increasing the hard minimum clearance in `TerrainPathfinder.rebuild_graph` to 2.5 meters and the repulsive clearance radius to 7.5 meters.\n\n\\n\\n\n**Investigating Sample Drop**\n\nI'm also digging into why a sample was missed at t=162. The predicted distance was only 0.91m! I need to examine `ready_to_sample` in `rover_controller.py` and `_systematic_resample` in `rover_estimator.py` to identify the cause, as there was a 0.84m systematic lag in the drives.\n\n\n**Correcting Uncertainty Calculations**\n\nI've pinpointed a crucial overconfidence issue related to `slip_base` uncertainty in the estimator. The 36 ensemble particles were using the same `self.slip_mean`, leading to an inaccurate representation of the total uncertainty in the `r90` spread. To fix this, I've modified `predict_state_at_tick` so each particle draws a `slip_k` incorporating `slip_base` uncertainty. I'm also tightening `ready_to_sample` to address the sample drop at t=162!\n\n\n**Resolving Base Distance Paradox**\n\nI've been wrestling with the perplexing base distance discrepancy in seed 101's mission. Why did `run_campaign` with `seed=101` end at `75.66m` from base with `batt=77.6`, while `sim.active_idx=1` landed at `0.95m`? I'm now comparing `autopilot.py` and `rover_controller.py` in both scenarios, as neither uses global random, and focusing on the crucial `MissionController` initialization differences.\n\n\n**Uncovering Deterministic Implication**\n\nI've made a breakthrough! The non-deterministic factor between the runs of `MissionController` is `time.perf_counter()` used in `solve_tour`. This explains the discrepancy: CPU load impacted LNS iterations, leading to a different tour selection in the campaign run. The selected path in the campaign run caused a `safety_stop` at `t=193`, which triggered the `sent_cmds.pop` bug! This desynchronized `est` from `true_pos`, leading to the 75m error! This fully explains the issue.\n\n\n","time":{"start":1794711604522,"end":1794711668770}}}
